title: elaeocarpus submonoceras subsp. procerus
intro: Elaeocarpus submonoceras subsp. procerus, commonly known as a species of Elaeocarpus, is a plant that belongs to the Elaeocarpaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including the ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Elaeocarpus submonoceras subsp. procerus include vasodilation, which can help to reduce blood pressure, and anti-inflammatory effects, which can help to reduce pain and swelling. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
